sourceText:
Stuffed Okra
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 10:41pm

Ingredients




pound Fresh okra, whole
1 tablespoon Coriander, ground
1 tablespoon Cumin, ground
2 teaspoons Lemon juice
teaspoon Cayenne pepper
teaspoon Salt
Black pepper
1 small Onion, halved lengthwise & cut crosswise into fine half rings
6 tablespoons Vegetable oil

Preparation

1 Rinse okra & pat dry. Trim. In a small bowl, mix together the coriander, cumin, lemon juice, cayenne, salt & black pepper. 2 One at a time, holding the okra in one hand, make a long slit in it using a sharp knife; don't go right through the pod & leave 1/4" at either end. Press the stuffing into the slit. Stuff all the okra pods this way. 3 Over a medium-high heat, heat the oil in a frying pan large enough to hold the okra in a single layer. Put in the onion & stir fry until it just begins to brown. Put in the okra in a single layer & reduce heat to medium-low. Okra should cook slowly, uncovered. Gently turn the pods until all sides are golden & very lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Cover pan, reduce heat to low & simmer for 5 minutes.
